goal: Test whether a local split of the inherited mesh can create a clean animated mouth
steps: Measured Bone02 weights and action motion in Blender; rendered matching close-ups.
Attempted weight-based lower-jaw separation, then local planar cut, then explicit jaw weight reassignment.
Inspected idle and attack side/front renders and rejected all variants for visible topology defects.
observations: Attempt01 selected all 6002 faces due Blender edit-mode selection synchronization; preserved as failed automation run.
Attempt02 opened a jagged seam; attempt03 remained closed; attempt04 opened but tore the cheek and produced a spike at the hinge.
A clean result requires head topology reconstruction with separate upper/lower surfaces and mouth cavity.

checks.name: clean mouth topology and cheek deformation
ready for Unity import
checks.evidence: All four variants rejected; no candidate GLB exported
